collect.question: Confirm you are speaking with someone who can answer questions on this topic; if not, ask who can and how to reach them.
Ask each question from the call objective, one at a time, and let them finish each answer.
For each answer, pin down the specifics: exact amounts, dates, names, reference numbers, and next steps, as applicable.
Repeat the key answers back and ask them to confirm you have them right.

end_conditions: All objective questions are answered and confirmed (success).
The business cannot answer today and names who will follow up and when.
goal: Get clear, specific answers to the questions in the call objective from the right person at the business, and confirm each answer back so there is no ambiguity in the record.
loop_in_triggers: They ask for any personal identifier, account credential, or one-time code.
They will only discuss the matter with Nathan himself.
Answering would require Nathan to make a decision that is not in the allowed list.
name: information_gathering
success_conditions: Every question in the objective has a specific answer or an explicit 'we don't have that yet' with a named next step.
Key answers were repeated back and confirmed.
title: Information gathering
